Master of Science in Computer Science

The Master of Science in Computer Science at Example State University prepares students for careers in machine learning, systems, and security research and industry.

Research Areas

Faculty research areas include machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and cybersecurity.

Application Deadlines

The application deadline for Fall 2027 admission is December 15, 2026 for all applicants.

Admission Requirements

Applicants should have a minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale. International applicants must submit a TOEFL iBT score of at least 90.

Required documents: a statement of purpose, three letters of recommendation, and official transcripts from all institutions attended.

Our department is located in Springfield, Illinois and welcomes applicants from around the world. This paragraph adds length so that the page contains enough readable text for extraction to run reliably in tests.
